question: Financial Inclusion Index 2025 was released by___________.
solution: The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • The **Financial Inclusion Index (FI Index)** is released by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** annually to measure the extent of financial inclusion across the country. • It was first introduced in **2021** by the RBI as a comprehensive measure to assess the level of financial inclusion. • The index is composed of three broad parameters: **Access** (35%), **Usage** (45%), and **Quality** (20%). These are further divided into multiple dimensions with a total of 97 indicators. • The FI Index ranges from **0 to 100**, where 0 represents complete financial exclusion, and 100 indicates full financial inclusion. • It is a **holistic and composite index** that captures information on various aspects of financial inclusion, such as banking penetration, availability of services, and usage of financial products.
